lesson: Virtual machine environments typically lack physical Bluetooth hardware. Check if Bluetooth adapters are available before attempting Bluetooth operations in VMs.
Desktop workstations and virtual machines do not have battery hardware. Battery status indicators and power management features are only available on laptop/mobile systems.
Software version numbers follow semantic versioning. Before configuring a specific version, verify that version exists (e.g., Python 3.x exists, but Python 4.x does not exist yet).
Shell variables must be defined before use. Commands referencing undefined variables (like $sourceDir, $targetDir) will fail. Check variable definitions with 'echo $VAR' or 'printenv'.

Switching users in Linux requires ending the current session ('su' terminates the original session, GUI user switching logs out). Maintaining an active session while switching users is architecturally incompatible.
